forcedChoices.choice: alcanzar a Dios en lo absoluto
forcedChoices.reason: «en absoluto» means «not at all» in Spanish; «en lo absoluto» keeps the sense of the absolute level.
«inframundo» carries the sense of the realm of the dead, which the authors did not intend.
«inconcuso» exists but is rare and means beyond doubt; «inconmovible» carries 'unshakable' plainly.
The quoted words address God as one person in a prayer form; Spanish prayer uses «tú».
The text addresses the reader; the plural «ustedes» per the Spanish rules.
«destino» is the glossary form for destiny; «fate» here is blind chance, so «sino» keeps the two apart.
Keeps both readings open: meanings of the cosmic mind, or cosmic 'mind meanings' (0:0.3).

forcedChoices.choice: el concepto de Deidad de los universos
forcedChoices.reason: Keeps open whether it is Deity's concept of the universes or the universes' Deity concept.
«actual» here is the plain sense of 'made real in fact'; «efectivo» avoids the false friend «actual».
